newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SFW shares rise on foreign thirst for wine.
newsitem.headline: SFW shares rise on foreign thirst for wine.

text.p: Stellenbosch Farmers Winery Group Ltd shares leapt on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange on Tuesday as foreigners' thirst for South African wines continued unabated, dealers said.
"Foreigners are buying a lot of South African wine...(Local producers) simply cannot produce enough wine for the foreigners," a dealer said.
The share added 81 cents or over seven percent on Tuesday rising to a record high of 12.01 rand after 13,000 shares changed hands in deals worth over 150,000 rand.
SFW shares have nearly doubled in value since the beginning of January when they were trading at 615 cents.
Dealers said there was still upward potential in the share.
"The share could go higher. Wine shares are the flavour of the month," one said.
